params.columns: k UInt64, a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64, d UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS a, a % 1000 AS b, k * 7 AS c, intDiv(k, 3) AS d FROM numbers({rows})

description: Validity probe for 1 000-row inserts (the metrics preset): 10 inserts (200 x scale 0.05) of 1 000 rows into 5 UInt64 columns, OPTIMIZE FINAL, full scan. io_bytes_per_op validity extends to 1 000 rows only if inserts.io_bytes.write lands within the fit tolerance.
